title: Emergency Wireless Station Of The Chinese Maritime Customs

W. Forrester, Esq.,
Acting Engineer-in-Chief,
The Chinese Maritime Customs,
Shanghai.

page_data.en:
CONFIDENTIAL

The Maritime Customs,
Engineer-in-Chief's Office.

Shanghai, 14th October 1937.

The Secretary,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir,

As I understand that in the present emergency
conditions the Council authorities require to be informed
concerning wireless transmitting apparatus located in the
Settlement, acting on the instructions of the Inspector General
of Customs I have to notify you that the Customs have installed
an emergency wireless station in their premises at 1708 Sinza
Road, and it is intended to put the station into service
immediately.

The technical details are as follows:-
Transmitter: 500 watts, continuous wave only,
Wave lengths: 35.5 metres and 50 metres,
and the station will operate with other Customs stations.

I shall be glad to furnish any further particulars
which may be required concerning the equipment.

Yours faithfully,

Sgd. W. Forrester,
Acting Engineer-in-Chief.
page_data.zh:
机密

海关总税务司署，
总工程师办公室。

上海，1937年10月14日。

秘书，
上海公共租界工部局，
上海。

亲爱的先生：

鉴于我了解到，在目前的紧急局势下，工部局当局要求获知位于租界内的无线电发射装置的情况，现遵照海关总税务司的指示，通知贵方：海关已在其位于新闸路1708号的处所内安装了一座应急无线电台，并拟立即将该台投入运行。

技术细节如下：
发射机：500瓦，仅连续波，
波长：35.5米和50米，
该台将与海关其他电台协同运作。

如需有关设备的进一步详情，本人乐意提供。

此致，

签署人 W. Forrester，
代理总工程师。
